failures_resolved: Native Chrome immediately granted mouse lock, then rejected setPointerCapture. Capture now precedes lock; already-locked clicks skip capture.
QA compared signed zero with strict vector equality and matched a button without its key-hint accessible text. Assertions corrected without changing simulation state.
Visual review found oversized station signs and overlapping narrow-layout hints. Signs now sit on station faces; narrow hints and controls have separate space.
limits: Native installed Chrome on this RTX 5090 desktop; narrow viewport controls are not physical-phone performance proof.
Three source-authored prototype rooms share one renderer. Repeated geometry/texture counts are bounded in this check, not proof of total GPU memory or long-session leaks.
Guided return is immediate; no manual docking, landing or disembark animation. The hangar sortie does not add atmospheric entry.
Voyage saves keep the capital orbital state. Reload resumes external flight; personal deck position and view mode last only for this visit.
Crew, combat, shields, damage, engineering and private quarters are not implemented.
Other browser engines, physical phones/laptops, Electron runtime, long play, fresh agent-session loading and real provider generation remain untested.
Quality-specific, safety and long terrain/depth-fallback suites were not rerun; historical receipts remain intact. Interior quality choices and context recovery were checked.
No commit, push, website deployment, asset transfer, paid generation or research submission.
